what_it_is: Cars,Cars, Cars. Prize cars in special colors, F-1 colors, Camaro Race car,7 RX-7LM, FTO LM,Subaru LM, others. Built up cars. Black cars. Over $1billion. Game is partially completed ~40%.
format: CodeBreaker save: 'CFU\0' header of 296 bytes (folder field 'BASCUS-97328GAMEDATA', title 'GRAN TURISMO 4 Game data'), RC4-encrypted zlib body of 1522184 bytes unpacking to 1528840 bytes: 4 files, 1528584 bytes of file data

title: GRAN TURISMO 4
Game data
save.times: as the file stores them (PS2 card times, JST)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'gran-turismo-4.7234.cbs' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BASCUS-97328GAMEDATA
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too
